definitions.explanation: The feeling of wanting to do something; motivation or eagerness to act.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はやる{気|き}に{満|み}ちている。
やる{気|き}があれば{何|なん}でもできる。
examples.english: You can do anything if you have the motivation.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- やる{気|き}が{出|で}る (to get motivated)
- やる{気|き}が{出|で}ない (to not feel motivated)
- やる{気|き}を{出|だ}す (to summon motivation)
- やる{気|き}に{満|み}ちている (to be full of motivation)
- やる{気|き}がある (to be motivated)
- やる{気|き}がない (to lack motivation)

USAGE NOTES:
- This is a casual/conversational term commonly used in everyday speech.
- More formal alternatives include {意欲|いよく} and モチベーション.
